invented: INVENTED. Not a capture. The reference fixture has to exercise every mapped field at once — concept DOI, ORCID'd creators, a mapped licence, a file, a community-derived task — and no single live Zenodo record does all of it. The payload is shaped like a Zenodo record response but every identifier is synthetic: the reserved 10.5072 DataCite TEST prefix and the sandbox host, neither of which resolves, so this fixture makes no claim about any real work. The real-capture fixtures are zen-02..zen-05 and zen-08..zen-11.

source.notes: Ten-minute statistics from a scanning lidar deployed at the Østerild National Test Centre during 2021. Includes horizontal wind speed, direction and turbulence intensity at eleven measurement heights.
